# pjsip / fuzz-audio

pjsip's own fuzz target `fuzz-audio` ([source](source/fuzz-audio.c), unmodified), one of the targets OSS-Fuzz builds, over pjproject (pjsip/pjproject at 708f894e).

For each registered audio codec (G.711 A/U-law, G.722, GSM, Speex, iLBC, L16 8/16/48 kHz, Opus when built) on a non-overlapping chunk: codec modify (VAD bit from input), decode the chunk, re-encode the decoded PCM, encode the chunk as PCM, parse, and PLC recover twice; then pjmedia_linear2alaw/ulaw and alaw2linear/ulaw2linear/alaw2ulaw/ulaw2alaw over the remaining bytes. Every result is discarded: decode->encode and linear->alaw->linear look like round trips but nothing is compared.

## How this program differs from what OSS-Fuzz runs
- Linked against pjproject at commit 708f894e with 1 patch to the library (listed on the project page).
- In every build, getenv() returns NULL, getpid() returns 1 and mkstemp() uses a fixed name, so the program depends only on its input.
- A small driver reads the input file, calls the harness one to four times and prints each return value.

## What the harness checks
The harness makes no check of its own beyond not crashing, so a statement about it says only that the code it calls never crashes, hangs or trips a sanitizer.

## Builds
Static riscv64 Linux programs, compiled for RV64G and run as `<file> <input-file>`; `oft fetch pjsip` downloads the published ones and checks each against its SHA-256.

| build | file | bytes | sha256 |
|---|---|---:|---|
| plain | `fuzz-audio.plain` | 438,944 | `b60fe947d4b24711164607da8f960a26533d8141b0282f9155d635a74ce52033` |
| ubsan | `fuzz-audio.ubsan` | 539,816 | `97a857ba3efc83583eb702b41ad6298ed801af4b4d3a715d800f69749272294d` |
| asan | `fuzz-audio.asan` | 1,661,296 | `6b6253ce0cbd6e57acb653501435f8c49fc0a76683de87c3d5c2178c33439649` |

Each build also links code that no sanitizer instruments, as its link recorded it. A statement about a sanitizer build covers that code only as uninstrumented code: ASan checks no load or store made inside it, and UBSan inserts no check there.

- plain: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library), `libmount.a` (a library from the build image), `libuuid.a` (a library from the build image)
- ubsan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library), `libmount.a` (a library from the build image), `libuuid.a` (a library from the build image)
- asan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.asan.a` (the sanitizer runtime), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc++.a` (the C++ runtime), `libc.a` (the C library), `libmount.a` (a library from the build image), `libunwind.a` (the C++ runtime), `libuuid.a` (a library from the build image)
- asan-ubsan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.asan.a` (the sanitizer runtime), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc++.a` (the C++ runtime), `libc.a` (the C library), `libmount.a` (a library from the build image), `libunwind.a` (the C++ runtime), `libuuid.a` (a library from the build image)
